sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Woman with short dark brown swept-up wavy/rolled hair, arched dark brows, a narrow vertical scar rising from screen-right brow and a faint oblique scar/line on screen-right cheek. No hat or eyeglasses. Head angled a little toward screen left with a composed slightly parted mouth holding a slender brown smoking roll projecting down-left, smoke rising at screen left. Muted red/pink blouse has a broad folded rounded collar, a small rectangular center clasp/buckle and scattered small pale studs on shoulders/chest. Preserve visible scar groups, hair silhouette, one mouth holding the same smoking prop, pose/crop/light and full charcoal/gray painted rectangular backing. Tiny scar edges, individual stud relief and burning-tip details are not readable exactly.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Woman with brown hair smoothly center parted and swept into a low bun, brown brows, large gold-rim rounded aviator-style tinted eyeglasses and a gentle closed-lip smile in slight screen-left near-frontal pose. Olive/mustard garment has a broad rounded open neck, filled by a prominent gold chain necklace with seven visible large dark oval/drop pendants framed in gold and warm pink centers. Preserve the bun, eyeglass shape, actual necklace arrangement across the upper chest, open-neck clothing, bust crop, soft left light and complete charcoal-to-gray painted rectangle. Fine gold settings, lens reflections and individual tiny chain links are unresolved, not license to invent extra jewelry.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man with short dark brown hair combed back and parted slightly to one side, dark hairy brows, no glasses or hat, serious small closed/downturned lips and eyes looking slightly upward toward screen left. A conspicuous curved/angled scar runs down the screen-right cheek from below eye toward mouth/jaw. Brown broad-lapel suit jacket over pale gray/white pointed-collar shirt and a red/burgundy tie with wide pale gray diagonal stripes. Preserve exact visible cheek scar group, source hairstyle, no beard/moustache, original tie stripes, pose/close bust/crop/light and full dark charcoal/gray painted backing. Tiny scar branching and fabric weave are not resolved; do not add a second mouth or human nose.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Bearded man in slight screen-left three-quarter view, short dark brown side hair mostly under a taupe/beige fedora with wide dark brown band. Dark hairy brows, low-set round dark/tinted metal-rim spectacles, brown moustache and full jaw/chin beard; lips form one stern slightly parted mouth. Raised dark brown trench-coat collar and broad lapels over a narrow dark red/rust knit garment visible at center throat. Preserve hat tilt/band, actual lowered glasses placement, visible hair/beard groups, original coat/inner red garment layering, close bust, upper-left lighting and full charcoal/gray painted rectangular background. Smooth away human nose and ears while retaining features on the rounded mascot face; do not reproduce a long narrow human neck. Tiny lens reflections, hair strands and cloth texture are unresolved.
